title: KDIGO Clinical Practice Guideline for Acute Kidney Injury
raw_extract: Source-linked educational summary: medication exposure and vulnerability may warrant AKI risk review. This registry has no patient-specific effect estimate.

title: AHA/ACC/HFSA Guideline for the Management of Heart Failure
raw_extract: Source-linked educational summary: heart-failure guidance emphasizes assessment of congestion and volume status. The sandbox does not predict response to an infusion.

title: FDA DailyMed - Morphine Sulfate Label
raw_extract: Source-linked educational summary: the label reports altered morphine pharmacokinetics in cirrhosis and warns about respiratory depression. It reports inadequate pharmacokinetic studies in severe hepatic impairment.
